notes: Single stream (concurrency 1): 20 sequential requests per variant, 5 prompts, temperature 0.7, max_tokens 256, no warmup. Latency is end-to-end per request; throughput_tps is completion tokens divided by summed end-to-end request time (so it includes time to first token), which makes it single-stream speed, not server capacity. vllm_pool_gib_per_gpu is the memory vLLM preallocates (gpu_memory_utilization x GPU memory, mostly KV cache), not model weight size. weights_gb is filled from the vLLM startup log line 'Model weights take X GiB' once re-measured.

INT4.gpu_memory_note: Source of this reading is unknown; it is not comparable to the other variants' pool size. Re-measure.
